paragraphs: Shevna, brother of Hillel the Nasi. (Shevna, [Isaiah 22:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Isaiah.22.15).) [Sotah 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.21a.17) relates that Hillel studied Torah in poverty while Shevna engaged in business. Eventually Shevna told Hillel, “Come, let us pool our shares and divide them.” A heavenly voice responded, “[If a man would give all the wealth of his house](https://www.sefaria.org/Song_of_Songs.8.7),” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sotah account has Rav Dimi reporting that Hillel and Shevna were brothers. The heavenly voice quotes Song of Songs. Isaiah supplies the biblical name-form.
